title: Event Feed Information

publisher.description: The organization responsible for publishing the feed. Examples: Virginia Department of Transportation, Kentucky Transportation Cabinet, Consultant ABC, Vendor XYZ. Do not abbreviate or use acronyms.

contact_name.description: The name of the individual or group responsible for publishing the data feed.

contact_email.description: The email address of the individual or group responsible for publishing the data feed.

update_frequency.description: The frequency in seconds at which the data feed is updated.

update_date-time.description: The UTC (Coordinated Universal Time) date and time when the GeoJSON file (representing the instance of the feed) was generated. Example: '2016-11-03T19:37:00Z'.

version.description: The Event specification version used to create the data feed, in 'major.minor' format. Example: version 1.6 or version 2.0

license.description: The URL of the license that applies to the data in the Event feed. This *must* be the string "https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/".

data_sources.description: A list of specific data sources for the Event data in the feed.

FeedDataSource.title: Event Feed Data Source

data_source_id.description: Unique identifier for the organization providing Event data. This identifier is a Universally Unique Identifier (UUID) as defined in [RFC 4122] (https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc4122). The UUID will remain constant (will not change over time) representing the owner of the data.

organization_name.description: The name of the organization for the authoritative source of the work zone data. Examples: Virginia Department of Transportation, Kentucky Transportation Cabinet, Consultant ABC, Vendor XYZ. Do not abbreviate the organization's name or use acronyms.

contact_name.description: The name of the individual or group responsible for the data source.

contact_email.description: The email address of the individual or group responsible for the data source.

update_frequency.description: The frequency in seconds at which the data source is updated. Example: ('60' = 1 minute); ('-1' = not being updated); ('0' - update on change)

update_date-time.description: The UTC date and time when the data source was last updated. Example: '2016-11-03T19:37:00Z'.

FeedDataSource.description: Describes information about specific data source(s) used to build the Event data feed. Examples: Virginia Department of Transportation, Kentucky Transportation Cabinet, Consultant ABC, Vendor XYZ

description: Describes Event feed header information such as metadata, contact information, and data sources.
